resources.string: Paste uses the open chat. Attach opens Discord’s attachment flow.
Use Attach for videos. The original file is kept.
Attach this media to the original Discord chat’s draft
Discord accepted the attachment into its draft.
Paste or Attach adds this file to the original chat’s draft. Press Send in Discord.
For Paste, focus Discord’s chat field before opening SAO. Enable Discord under SAO in Vector, or enable Paste assistance.
